## Source

*The Roanoke Times*, Roanoke, Virginia · Wednesday, December 11, 1935, page 3.
## Transcription

Charles R. Smith

Christiansburg, Dec. 10 (Special) -- Charles R Smith died this afternoon at his home in Cambria. Surviving are his wife, Mrs. Mona Rush Smith, and three children, Charles Richard, Jr., David and Frances Smith. Funeral services will be held at the Cambria Methodist hurch Thursday at 2 p.m. conducted by the Rev. Mr. McCormick, and burial will be in Sunset cemetery.
